description: AI-powered collaborative design tool from Tencent
##: The website only links a moving .../Ardot_Setup_latest_x86_64.exe URL. The versioned URL below is taken from the vendor's WinSparkle appcast at https://static.d.gtimg.com/windows/x86_64/ArdotAppcast.xml, so cached downloads stay tied to one version; the two files were byte-identical at 2.28.13.
checkver reads the same appcast and captures the version from the newest <enclosure>, which the feed lists first.
Only a Windows x86_64 build is published: windows/arm64 and windows/x86 appcasts return 404, so the manifest is 64-bit only.
The 187 MiB Inno Setup 6.7 installer is unpacked with innounp. Its files are flat under {app}, with Ardot.exe at the root, so no extract_dir or installer script is needed.

The appcast publishes only an EdDSA signature, not a SHA-256/MD5, and there is no checksum sidecar. autoupdate.hash is therefore omitted so Excavator downloads the new installer to recompute the hash.
The installer normally registers ArdotBridge and the font helper as Run keys; extraction skips those and Ardot.exe launches both helpers itself by relative path.
notes: A bundled WinSparkle updater checks the vendor appcast on launch. Let Scoop own upgrades with 'scoop update ardot'; an in-app update would run the Inno installer into its own location and break this package.
